title: Consistent with baseline
description: Thirty stable sessions with no recent deviation.

title: Recent variation
description: A single-signal recent shift that does not persist.

title: Persistent change
description: A multi-signal recent shift plus an anomaly flag on the trigger.

title: Sudden change
description: A sharp multi-signal shift confined to the two most recent sessions.

title: Recovery
description: An earlier multi-signal shift that has returned to the baseline.

title: Insufficient history
description: Only three stored sessions: below the model minimum.

title: Data-quality issue
description: A dense valid history plus one stored row that fails validation.
